answer: A Sybil-resistant agent market can assign each new identity a random proof-of-work audit tied to independently signed records. An agent might reconcile a pearl shipment against customs receipts, check a mirror factory's energy meter, or validate a karst water survey. Its credential activates only when separate auditors verify the evidence. Faking many identities thus demands distinct genuine records or corrupting multiple auditors, with each failed attempt forfeiting a posted deposit.
